breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the flexural second moment with a polar moment in the curvature relation, even though beam bending curvature is governed by M/(E I).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states to use I (the flexural second moment of area) and not the polar second moment J in the curvature relation. It correctly applies κ = M/(E I) rather than κ = M/(E J), fully aligning with the ground truth prompt which uses the standard beam bending curvature formula.
